subject: general
question:
In the given figure, AB is parallel to CD. Angle PAB = 70 degrees and angle DCP = 110 degrees. What is the value (in degrees) of angle APC?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39b644fe8303ad796dbe50ea4540624294d6eff1c64daf465754828225ae6f92.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Extend line CD to intersect segment AP at point E.

Since AB || CD, ∠PEC = ∠PAB = 70° (Corresponding angles).

Angle ∠ECP = 180° − ∠DCP = 180° − 110° = 70° (Linear pair).

In triangle PEC, ∠APC = 180° − (∠PEC + ∠ECP) = 180° − (70° + 70°) = 40°.

**∴ The correct answer is 40°.**
